bean.intent: Shipping estimates with business days. Independently negotiate precise shared shipping semantics through bean tools.

approach.summary: Implement a pure UTC-date shipping estimator in my own src/shipping.mjs. Validate strict ISO dates and nonnegative whole business-day counts; traverse calendar dates after shippedOn, counting Monday-Friday unless explicitly listed as holidays. Keep calendar elapsed days and counted business days separate for consumers.

promises.body: estimateDelivery({ shippedOn, businessDays, holidays = [] }) returns { days, businessDays, deliveryDate }. shippedOn and deliveryDate are strict YYYY-MM-DD UTC calendar dates. Counting starts AFTER shippedOn: businessDays counts Monday-Friday dates excluding explicit holiday dates, and days is elapsed calendar days between shippedOn and deliveryDate. businessDays = 0 returns the shippedOn date with days = 0 even on a weekend or holiday. The function is pure and throws on invalid dates or negative/fractional businessDays.
promises.conditions: Valid four-digit ISO calendar dates and nonnegative safe integer businessDays; holiday entries use the same strict UTC calendar-date format. No locale, machine timezone, or implicit holiday calendar affects results.
